headline: Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5, a small AI model it calls its fastest and cheapest yet, at much lower prices.
score_reason: Pool score 8 kept: a major model launch with large price cuts, stated in Anthropic's release and reported by The Decoder.
importance_line: Companies and developers running high-volume AI tasks such as support chat can cut costs, but the honest doubt is that the new tokenizer may use more billed units per task, so real savings could be smaller than the prices suggest.
summary: The Decoder reports that Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5, with prices about 75 percent lower on average than Haiku 4.5, and up to 90 percent lower for prompts up to 100,000 tokens. The model is aimed at high-volume jobs such as summaries and customer support, though The Decoder notes that the new tokenizer, the system that splits text into the units that are billed, may use slightly more of them, so real savings could be smaller.
notes: Read in full from The Decoder (3,515 chars). Prices and benchmark figures are Anthropic's, as reported. Subscription and advertising lines ignored.
